title.zh: From GTA V on iPhone to Free Photoshop: This AI Tool Is Upending Software
title.en: From GTA V on iPhone to Free Photoshop: This AI Tool Is Upending Software

current_state.zh: The open-source REA toolkit, which connects AI coding agents to reverse-engineering tools such as Ghidra, exploded past 100,000 GitHub stars as developers used it with Claude Opus 5.5 to decompile and port games and build free clean-room alternatives to paid software.
